card.description:
JELD-WEN is currently seeking a Plant Manager to join our growing team.

 

JELD-WEN is currently seeking a Plant Manager – Craigsville, WV, to join our team.

 

**Summary:** Under the general direction of the Regional Operations Director, the Plant Manager (PM) position is responsible for and directs and manages all plant operations. This position has the overall responsibility for production at their respective manufacturing facility, and for driving JELD-WEN’s Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s), including, but not limited to, SQDCI, JOS, and Continuous Improvement (CI) activities and initiatives in direct support of JELD-WEN’s Mission Statement for their respective product line.

 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

 

* Directs and manages all plant operations following JELD-WEN’s Mission Statement and Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s).
* Coordinates all plant activities by working with the management team to ensure that total manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a timely, cost-effective, and efficient manner.
* Develops, controls, plans, and implements the plant budget to maximize profits by utilizing SQDCI, JOS, OTD, and Continuous Improvement (CI) initiatives.
* Implements cost-effective systems of control over operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries, and manages capital asset/improvement projects.
* Establishes and monitors overall plant performance for safety, production, and quality standards, working closely with support groups where appropriate.
* Maintains existing plant facilities and equipment; replaces or submits requests for adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary and as needed.
* Coordinates plant and production activities through strategic planning with the Director of Operations to ensure that total manufacturing objectives are aligned following JELD-WEN’s Mission Statement and KPI’s.
* Oversee the implementation of safety and preventative maintenance programs, incorporating and driving safety procedures and plant cleanliness as a priority.
* Provides leadership and training to accomplish corporate goals/objectives/KPI’s.
* Provides direction, development, and leadership to managerial personnel.
* Hires, trains, develops, and appraises staff effectively. Takes corrective actions as necessary and in a timely manner, following company policy. Consults with Human Resources, Legal, and/or corporate offices as needed on the same.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Wood Science/Forest Resources, Engineering, Business, or a related field, and at least seven (7) to ten (10) years’ experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Advanced knowledge and experience in production and manufacturing process improvement techniques including, but not limited to, SQDCI, TPS, OTD, and Continuous Improvement (CI) initiatives and methodologies.
* LEAN manufacturing and/or production process experience is a must.
* Strong knowledge of business, finance, quality control systems, and standards.
* Advanced leadership, interpersonal, technical aptitude, and problem-solving skills, and the ability to lead and drive manufacturing process improvement techniques through the production process skillfully and deliberately.
* A team player, and the ability to coach and mentor managerial personnel, and instill JELD-WEN’s Mission and cultural values in all plant personnel.
* Superior motivational skills and the ability to train and drive CI methods and initiatives into managers and subordinate personnel.
* Fundamental knowledge of engineering principles and practices.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to include corporate personnel and managers, and rank-and-file plant personnel.
* Advanced knowledge of management principles and practices.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from corporate, groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and other position-applicable software applications.
* Strong knowledge of plant/OSHA health and safety standards and compliance.
* Travel: up to 15% +/-.

 

#LI-KC1

 

**About JELD-WEN Holding, Inc.**

 

JELD-WEN Holding, Inc. (NYSE: JELD) is a leading global designer, manufacturer and distributor of high-performance interior and exterior doors, windows and related building products serving the new construction and repair and remodeling sectors. Based in Charlotte, North Carolina, the company operates across North America and Europe. Our associates are dedicated to bringing beauty and security to the spaces that touch our lives through our market-leading product brands across the world. The JELD-WEN family of brands includes JELD-WEN® worldwide, LaCantina® and VPI™ in North America, and Swedoor® and DANA® in Europe. For more information, visit corporate.JELD-WEN.com or follow LinkedIn.

JELD-WEN has been named by *Forbes* as one of ‘America’s Best Employers’ and by *Newsweek* as one of the ‘World’s Most Trustworthy Companies’.

 

**What We Offer**

Investing in People is one of our Core Values, we strive to attract & retain great people! As such, JELD-WEN offers competitive compensation & benefits packages. As a global organization, specific benefits may vary, however typically including medical & dental, generous leave policies, retirement program, etc.

JELD-WEN is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not tolerate discrimination, harassment, and/or retaliation based on individuals’ physical traits, beliefs, and/or other characteristics that are protected under applicable laws.

JELD-WEN does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.

card.description:
**Why you will love working at Maola Local Dairies™**:

* Built on over a century of dedication, Maola is always looking ahead investing in our people, strengthening our communities, and securing fresh, local dairy for the future.
* Join a farmer-owned cooperative rooted in integrity, sustainability, and a passion for providing fresh, high-quality Maola dairy products.
* We prioritize your well-being with competitive pay, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, and more
* Our employees are an integral part of who we are — what you do and what you think matters.

**SUMMARY:**

The Plant Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for all manufacturing at Maola Local Dairies – Philadelphia. 
 
You will execute strategies to optimize safety, food quality, performance, equipment reliability, cost-effectiveness, and profitability. You will build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement while developing a high-performing leadership team to drive sustainable results. This role requires a hands-on, results-oriented leader with extensive manufacturing experience, technical expertise in fluid milk processing and packaging, strong financial acumen, and proven success in a unionized facility. You must translate company goals into clear departmental priorities and ensure consistent execution across the entire plant.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**1. Operational Leadership & Manufacturing Performance**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily plant operations, ensuring production schedules, customer requirements, and business objectives are consistently achieved.
* Establish and maintain operational standards that drive improvements in production efficiency, OEE, throughput, yield, and order fulfillment.
* Demonstrate strong technical understanding of pasteurization, UHT processing, fluid milk manufacturing, and packaging operations.
* Drive equipment reliability and asset utilization through effective partnership with Maintenance and Engineering leadership.
* Establish disciplined management routines, performance reviews, and accountability systems to identify and eliminate operational losses.
* Ensure effective coordination between Production, Maintenance, Quality, Sanitation, Warehousing, and Scheduling.

**2. Financial & Business Management**

* Maintain full operational and financial accountability for plant performance, including operating budgets, labor costs, maintenance expenditures, material utilization, and manufacturing costs.
* Partner with department leaders to establish, manage, and maintain departmental budgets.
* Monitor plant financial performance against established budgets and proactively address unfavorable variances.
* Develop and execute cost-reduction strategies focused on eliminating waste, reducing overtime, improving labor productivity, and optimizing maintenance expenditures.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of plant P&L performance, cost per unit, conversion costs, and key manufacturing financial indicators.
* Ensure department heads understand their financial responsibilities and maintain ownership of their respective budgets.

**3. TPM & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the implementation and sustainment of TPM principles and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the facility.
* Establish a culture focused on identifying, understanding, and eliminating the root causes of operational losses.
* Drive improvements in equipment reliability, preventive maintenance execution, planned maintenance, and overall asset effectiveness.
* Challenge normalized deviance and reinforce adherence to established operating standards and best practices.
* Develop structured problem-solving capabilities throughout the leadership team and frontline organization.
* Establish meaningful performance indicators and management routines to measure progress, sustain improvements, and reinforce accountability.

**4. Safety, Food Safety & Quality**

* Establish and maintain an uncompromising commitment to employee safety, food safety, and product quality.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety programs, and manufacturing standards.
* Partner with Quality and Sanitation leadership to prevent quality failures, reduce product holds, minimize waste, and protect customer confidence.
* Ensure incidents, deviations, and nonconformances receive appropriate investigation, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Promote proactive employee engagement and leadership participation in safety and quality initiatives.

**5. Leadership, Organizational Development & Labor Relations**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a capable and accountable management team.
* Establish clear performance expectations and ensure department leaders demonstrate ownership of their respective areas.
* Build organizational capability through leadership development, employee engagement, succession planning, and effective performance management.
* Demonstrate authentic, approachable, and visible leadership throughout all levels of the facility.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented environment that encourages initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate the ability to effectively lead and develop a unionized workforce through constructive labor relations, consistent application of collective bargaining agreements, and proactive employee engagement.
* Establish productive working relationships with union representatives and employees while balancing organizational objectives, workforce needs, and contractual obligations.
* Address employee relations matters with professionalism, consistency, fairness, and sound judgment.
* Promote a culture of mutual respect, accountability, and shared responsibility for operational performance.

**6. Customer & Executive Engagement**

* Effectively communicate plant performance, business challenges, operational priorities, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Represent the Philadelphia facility professionally in customer interactions, audits, and business reviews as needed.
* Ensure customer commitments, product quality expectations, and service requirements remain central to operational decision-making.
* Establish cross-functional partnerships that support broader organizational objectives and business growth.

**BASIC REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, preferably within the dairy, fluid milk, food, or beverage manufacturing industries required
* Minimum of 7 years of experience successfully leading a unionized manufacturing workforce, including labor relations, employee engagement, and collective bargaining agreement administration required.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience leading complex manufacturing operations with multiple production lines and supporting departments required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with technical knowledge of pasteurization, fluid milk processing, and packaging equipment and systems required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience managing operating budgets, departmental expenditures, and plant P&L performance required.
* Minimum of 5 year of experience in improving manufacturing efficiency, equipment reliability, labor productivity, and cost performance required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience implementing TPM, Lean Manufacturing, or other continuous improvement methodologies required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience leading, developing, and holding department-level leadership teams accountable for measurable results required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience understanding of food safety, quality systems, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety required.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Communication
* + *Communicate clearly and effectively through multiple channels – oral, written, visual, and non-verbal – ensuring our messages are understood and delivered appropriately, whether in-person or digitally.*
* Accountability
* + *Take responsibility for actions and anticipate challenges before they arise.*
 + *Solve problems both within and outside of departments, proactively addressing issues as they occur.*
* Customer Focused
* + *Prioritize understanding and meeting both internal and external customer needs.*
 + *Ensure high levels of satisfaction and loyalty by anticipating customer requirements and striving for exceptional service.*
* Initiative
* + *Proactive in identifying opportunities and addressing potential threats.*
 + *Act independently and decisively, rather than waiting for situations to demand action.*
* Problem-Solving
* + *Possess the ability to identify and address complex issues with minimal guidance.*
 + *Skilled at analyzing challenges and finding practical, effective solutions.*
* Collaboration
* + *Take responsibility for deliverables while also supporting others to ensure that collective goals are met.*
 + *Able to work harmoniously with others toward a common goal, recognizing and valuing each person’s contributions, is fundamental to successful collaboration.*

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand and walk. The employee must be able to reach, bend, extend, and lift 50-60 pounds.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The work environment may require working in the cooler room with varying degrees of temperature and may include contact with water or dairy liquids.
* Exposed to a noise level of 90 decibels. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate/high. Wet/slippery work conditions.

Maola processes milk, cream, butter, and dry milk powders through our network of six dairy processing plants. With a keen eye on quality, freshness, and love for the environment, Maola delivers dairy products that are both nutritious and sustainable to our local communities. For more information about Maola, please visit **www.maolamilk.com** (http://www.maolamilk.com/)**.**

card.description:
**Plant Manager**

Company: Norris Cylinder Company

Primary Location: 521 Green Cove Road SE, Huntsville, AL 35803 USA

Workplace Type: On-site

Employment Type: Salaried | Full-Time

Function: General / Executive Management

Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled

**Main Duties & Responsibilities**

**POSITION SUMMARY** 
The Plant Manager is responsible for the facility’s overall operational and financial performance, with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and employee engagement. This role leads a team of approximately 120-150 direct and indirect manufacturing employees, including key support functions such as quality, maintenance, shipping/receiving, order management, and supplier management. The position leads steel fabrication and associated support functions and develops the people, processes, and operating discipline required to meet customer and financial objectives.

**PLANT AND FINANCIAL LEADERSHIP** 
Lead plant operations with full accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and operating profit. 
Develop and execute budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, productivity targets, and capital plans. 
Monitor financial and operating performance; address adverse results through clear corrective actions. 
Control labor costs, overtime, premium freight, scrap, rework, outside processing, downtime, and operating expenses. 
Coordinate with engineering, supply chain, commercial, finance, human resources, and other business functions.

**SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE** 
Establish safety as the plant’s highest operational priority and ensure compliance with company, OSHA, environmental, permitting, and regulatory requirements. 
Maintain effective controls for machine guarding, lockout/tagout, hot work, powered industrial trucks, overhead cranes, welding fumes, PPE, and emergency response. 
Conduct plant walkthroughs and incident reviews; ensure hazards, injuries, near misses, and environmental concerns receive timely corrective action. 
Maintain high standards for housekeeping, material storage, scrap management, aisle control, and movement of steel and heavy components.

**MANUFACTURING OPERATIONS AND QUALITY** 
Direct steel fabrication processes, including cutting, bending, rolling, forming, welding, machining, assembly, finishing, inspection, and testing, as applicable. 
Establish daily management of production schedules, staffing, equipment, materials, capacity, and customer priorities. 
Ensure employees follow approved work instructions, process parameters, quality requirements, and standard operating procedures. 
Maintain controls for steel grade, material certification, heat or lot traceability, welding procedures, fabrication tolerances, dimensional accuracy, coatings, and final testing. 
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable AWS, ASME, DOT, customer, and product requirements. 
Lead root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective action for customer complaints, nonconforming material, scrap, rework, and recurring process failures.

**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND ASSET MANAGEMENT** 
Lead Operational Excellence and Lean methods, including 5S, standard work, visual management, value-stream mapping, setup reduction, mistake-proofing, and structured problem solving. 
Maintain a prioritized improvement plan with defined owners, timelines, expected benefits, and validated results. 
Ensure facilities, equipment, tooling, fixtures, cranes, ventilation, utilities, and material-handling systems are safely and effectively maintained. 
Establish preventive and predictive maintenance programs based on equipment risk and production requirements. 
Manage capital projects from justification through installation, validation, and post-implementation review.

**PEOPLE LEADERSHIP** 
Provide direction, coaching, and development to managers, supervisors, and other plant leaders. 
Establish clear expectations and hold leaders and employees accountable for results and behaviors. 
Build capability through hiring, onboarding, training, cross-training, succession planning, and leadership development. 
Partner with Human Resources on staffing, attendance, turnover, employee relations, performance management, and workforce planning. 
Promote positive employee relations through visible leadership, consistent communication, fair treatment, and shop-floor engagement.

**KEY PERFORMANCE MEASURES** 
Safety and environmental performance; on-time delivery and schedule attainment; first-pass yield, scrap, rework, and customer complaints; labor efficiency, productivity, and overtime; operating profit and conversion cost; equipment uptime; inventory accuracy; project performance; and employee turnover, attendance, training, and engagement.

 

**Qualifications**

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations management, business, or a related field. 
Seven or more years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership of managers, supervisors, or multiple manufacturing functions. 
Experience in steel fabrication, welding, machining, metalworking, heavy manufacturing, or a comparable industrial environment. 
Demonstrated responsibility for plant financial and operational performance, budgeting, production planning, quality systems, maintenance, supply chain, and Lean manufacturing. 
ISO 9001 experience and familiarity with applicable AWS, ASME, DOT, customer, or product standards preferred. 
Advanced degree, Lean Six Sigma certification, and experience with capital installations or automated fabrication processes preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** 
Strong safety leadership, manufacturing knowledge, financial judgment, and ability to translate business results into operating actions. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and organizational skills. 
Proven ability to develop leaders, build accountable teams, manage multiple priorities, and lead during operational disruptions. 
High integrity, accountability, resilience, and attention to detail.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** 
The position works in office and manufacturing environments and regularly enters fabrication, welding, machining, finishing, warehouse, and shipping areas. Exposure may include noise, heat, welding operations, fumes, dust, oils, moving equipment, and heavy materials. Required PPE must be worn. Availability to support multiple shifts, shutdowns, equipment issues, and significant customer or production concerns may be required.

**Benefits**

Benefit offerings include Medical Insurance and Prescription Drugs, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability Insurance (for eligible employees), Employee Assistance Plan (EAP), Paid Time Off (may include vacation and sick time), Retirement Program, and Other Voluntary Benefits.

card.description:
**Job Summary:** 
 
The **Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation** provides strategic leadership and execution support for priority operational initiatives in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and Operations leaders. This role translates organizational priorities into actionable implementation plans, leads assigned cross-functional initiatives, improves operational processes, and drives sustainable improvements in how work is performed.

The Director leads efforts to move initiatives from strategy through execution by developing implementation plans, establishing timelines and accountability, coordinating cross-functional activities, identifying risks and barriers, measuring progress, and providing clear visibility to leadership. The role also partners with teams to evaluate and redesign processes, strengthen procedures and documentation, improve cross-training and operational continuity, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through technology, automation, and self-service.

This role requires demonstrated experience leading operational improvement initiatives, managing complex projects, influencing across teams, and successfully implementing change. Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, project execution, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to drive accountability and deliver measurable results.

This role follows a hybrid work arrangement, with the majority of time worked remotely and periodic in-office requirements in our downtown Chicago office.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Implementation and Project Coordination** **(40%)**

* **Develop and maintain implementation plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and action items for priority Operations initiatives.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate activities across teams and follow up on commitments, deliverables, and outstanding actions.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Track project progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and issues requiring leadership attention.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Prepare concise status updates and other progress reporting for the COO and appropriate leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned cross-functional Operations initiatives from planning through implementation, working with department leaders to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver agreed upon outcomes.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Facilitate working sessions to clarify responsibilities, resolve implementation issues, and move work from discussion to action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with Operations leaders to advance agreed priorities, clarify responsibilities, and strengthen accountability while maintaining departmental ownership of ongoing operations.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Process Improvement (30%)**

* **Review and document selected operational processes and workflows.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work with staff to identify unnecessary steps, manual work, duplication, unclear handoffs, and other opportunities for improvement.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop practical recommendations to simplify workflows, improve consistency, and strengthen operational effectiveness.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leaders, including implementation and evaluation of results.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help develop and maintain standard operating procedures and other operational documentation.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthen cross-training and backup coverage for critical processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify appropriate opportunities to improve workflows through technology, automation, and self-service.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Change and Coordination (20%)**

* **Lead or coordinate implementation of assigned process, technology, and organizational changes within Operations, in partnership with the responsible department leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate operational activities associated with selected technology implementations and other modernization initiatives.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help ensure changes are supported by appropriate documentation, communications, training, and follow-up.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Bring together the appropriate staff and leaders when work crosses departmental boundaries.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help clarify responsibilities and handoffs when ownership is unclear.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify implementation barriers and work with the appropriate leaders to resolve or escalate them.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor recently implemented changes and help address issues affecting adoption or effectiveness.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Measurement and Reporting (10%)**

* **Establish practical measures for selected initiatives and operational improvements.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop baseline information when needed to evaluate the impact of a change.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor whether implemented changes are achieving expected results.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Use available operational data and staff or candidate feedback to identify areas requiring additional attention.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Provide the COO with clear visibility into progress, risks, workload, and outstanding decisions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Initial Focus Areas:**

*(Initial assignments are expected to include)*

* **Supporting implementation of priority Operations initiatives within DANB’s strategic roadmap.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establishing a consistent approach for planning, tracking, and reporting major Operations projects.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting process improvement in selected candidate-facing areas, including Document Review, Client Services, and Certification Operations.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and improve workflows through process redesign and technology.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthening procedures, documentation, cross-training, and backup coverage.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting implementation of approved changes to Operations roles, responsibilities, and processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Skills and Attributes:**

* **Strong organizational and project implementation skills with consistent attention to follow-through.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ability to organize complex work into clear plans, responsibilities, timelines, and next steps.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.**
 --------------------------------------------------------
* **Effective facilitator who can help teams move from discussion to decisions and action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**
 ---------------------------------------------------
* **Collaborative and skilled at building productive relationships across teams and functions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and recognize when issues require escalation.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and teams, establish accountability, and drive initiatives to completion without direct supervisory authority.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Practical approach to process improvement that avoids unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfortable learning new systems, technologies, and operational processes.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Education & Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience in operations, project implementation, process improvement, or business operations, including demonstrated responsibility for leading complex, cross-functional initiatives required.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated success leading initiatives from planning through implementation, including delivering measurable operational improvements.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience reviewing and improving business processes and workflows.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience supporting technology-enabled operational change preferred.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in certification, credentialing, assessment, associations, nonprofits, healthcare, or another regulated environment is preferred.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Physical Demands:**

Required to sit for extended periods of time; may need to walk or stand in the course of work as well as light (20-30 lbs.) to medium (30-40 lbs.) levels of lifting of supplies and/or equipment.

**Work Environment:**

Work performed in an office environment, either onsite or offsite; periodic travel to be expected (<10%)

card.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
card.description:
**Relocation assistance is available for this position.**

**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

SENS is seeking a manufacturing engineering leader to help build and scale the organization, processes, and technical capabilities required for our next stage of growth. Supporting the expansion of existing manufacturing operations and establishing new operations at our Broomfield Systems manufacturing factory, this leader will establish the manufacturing engineering strategy, develop a multidisciplinary team, and translate business growth plans into manufacturing capacity and reliable production processes for our fastest-growing products.

This role leads manufacturing engineering, industrialization, tooling, test systems, automation, and technical production support for our systems products, with a strong emphasis on configure-to-order assembly manufacturing. Working closely with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, the Senior Manager will establish clear priorities, strengthen new product and production transfer readiness, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost, and equipment reliability.

A successful candidate will combine organizational leadership with practical technical judgment, building a team that can support daily production while executing the improvements and investments needed to scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Help to build and develop the manufacturing engineering organization. Assess current capabilities, define the team structure and staffing plan, recruit talent, and develop engineers and technical leaders to support SENS’s growth.
* Establish performance measures and execution discipline. Set departmental goals, review project and operational performance, communicate risks and resource needs, and hold the team accountable for measurable improvements in manufacturing readiness, capacity, productivity, and equipment reliability.
* Establish and execute the manufacturing engineering roadmap. Translate business growth, product plans, and production requirements into prioritized initiatives for manufacturing capacity, processes, tooling, test systems, automation, and equipment reliability.
* Lead manufacturing readiness for new products and production transfers. Partner with Design Engineering, Production, Quality, and Planning & Fulfillment to establish readiness criteria and ensure processes, equipment, tooling, test capability, documentation, and training are in place before production release.
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes and standards. Establish consistent methods for process development, validation, work instructions, engineering changes, and production controls across manufacturing locations while accommodating product-specific requirements.
* Expand manufacturing capacity and improve productivity. Lead engineering efforts in capacity analysis, line balancing, factory layout, workflow, cycle-time reduction, and constraint elimination to support production demand and improve labor efficiency.
* Provide reliable technical support to Production. Establish clear support coverage, escalation processes, and problem-solving practices that resolve production issues promptly and prevent recurrence while maintaining progress on strategic projects.
* Guide manufacturing technology development. Lead technical specialists responsible for manufacturing test systems, production software, tooling, and automation. Prioritize investments based on safety, quality, capacity, reliability, and financial return.
* Improve production equipment reliability. Establish equipment ownership, maintenance strategies, critical spare requirements, and preventive and predictive maintenance practices in partnership with Production and technical support teams.
* Manage projects, capital investments, and departmental resources. Develop business cases, budgets, schedules, and resource plans; oversee implementation and production acceptance; and verify that projects deliver their expected operational and financial benefits.
* Partner with Design Engineering on manufacturability. Incorporate manufacturing feedback early in product development and engineering changes to improve assembly, testability, quality, serviceability, and cost.
* Drive safe processes and sustained quality improvement. Partner with EHS and Quality to incorporate risk assessment, error prevention, root cause analysis, and corrective action into manufacturing processes and equipment changes.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of manufacturing processes, work instructions, test procedures, tooling, fixtures, automation systems, and production software solutions.
* Be directly accountable for engineering project delivery, manufacturing readiness, equipment reliability, and validated improvement benefits, while sharing accountability with Production and Quality for labor efficiency and first-pass yield (FPY).

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, or an additional 4 tears of manufacturing engineering experience.
* Eight or more years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, or a related technical manufacturing role.
* Three or more years of experience directly leading engineering or technical teams, including setting priorities, developing employees, allocating resources, and managing performance.
* Demonstrated success improving manufacturing performance, with measurable results in productivity, capacity, quality, cost, or equipment reliability.
* Experience developing and improving manufacturing processes, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and production controls, including introducing new or revised products into production.
* Ability to lead engineers and technical specialists across manufacturing processes, test systems, automation, and production support, using sound technical judgment to evaluate solutions and resolve issues.
* Practical application of Lean Manufacturing and structured problem-solving methods, including root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects with Production, Design Engineering, Quality, Safety, and Supply Chain, balancing daily production needs with longer-term improvement priorities.
* Experience planning and executing manufacturing improvement or capital equipment projects, including defining scope, schedules, resource requirements, and expected business results.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into clear team priorities and communicate progress, risks, and decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in manufacturing of configure-to-order (CTO) and engineered-to-order (ETO) electrical systems such as switchgear, switchboard, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing software development, automated test systems, and data acquisition platforms.
* Experience using ERP systems such as SyteLine for BOM management, item masters, engineering changes, and manufacturing planning.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent certification.
* Experience managing departmental budgets and capital equipment projects from business case through production acceptance.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $120,000 - $175,000 is the projected annual base salary range for this role and will be determined on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 15th. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Professional development

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

card.description:
**Please Note: This position's start date is January 11th 2027.**

**Job Description**

Are you an ambitious operations leader, shift supervisor, or production lead looking to take the next major step in your career?

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on **Plant Manager** to lead the daily operations of our production, packaging, fulfillment, receiving, inventory, and warehouse functions. Reporting directly to the VP of Product + Logistics, you will be responsible for ensuring our product moves safely, accurately, and efficiently through the business.

As a small but rapidly growing company, we need a "systems builder" who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves on the floor. Because we are a tight-knit team, we are deeply committed to your professional development. If you have an outstanding track record of leadership and team-building, but have gaps in specific technical areas—such as advanced food safety or warehouse software—we are fully prepared to invest in your training and certifications to help you bridge those gaps.

**Why This Role is a Unique Growth Opportunity**

* **Direct Mentorship:** Work hand-in-hand with our VP of Product + Logistics to learn the strategic side of supply chain, budgeting, and operations.
* **Professional Development Fund:** If your food safety background is solid but not yet at a master level, we will fund and support your path to official HACCP, PCQI, or advanced food safety certifications.
* **Ownership & Impact:** You won't just be executing someone else's playbook; you will design and implement the systems (from WMS architecture to preventive maintenance) that will power our brand's next phase of growth.

**Key Responsibilities1. Production Planning & Preventive Maintenance**

* **Master Production Scheduling:** Move us from day-to-day planning to proactive operational excellence. You will own the Master Production Schedule (MPS), using sales forecasts, historical data, and retail demands to plan batch runs weeks in advance.
* **Production Oversight:** Manage the physical processing, grinding, sifting, kitting, labeling, and sealing of our artisan products.
* **Preventive Maintenance (PM):** Design and enforce a strict PM calendar for our machinery (grinders, mills, sifters) to prevent costly breakdowns.

**2. Inventory Strategy & Warehouse Architecture**

* **WMS Implementation:** Lead the strategy and physical layout for our Warehouse Management System (WMS), including mapping warehouse bins, establishing min/max reorder thresholds, and training the team on barcode scanning software.
* **Inventory Flow:** Maintain strict First Expired, First Out (FEFO) rules to minimize waste and optimize physical space.
* **Stock Optimization:** Oversee regular stocktakes, resolve POS discrepancies, and manage inventory levels across our warehouse, retail storefronts, and external markets.

**3. People Leadership & Team Development**

* **Cross-Training & Training Matrices:** Build and maintain a robust "Training Matrix" so that critical roles (such as running the mill or pulling retail transfers) are never dependent on a single person.
* **Staff Development:** Direct, schedule, and coach our hourly production, fulfillment, and receiving teams.
* **Accountability:** Conduct regular performance reviews, set clear quality standards, and directly address performance issues constructively.

**4. Fulfillment, Logistics & Financial Control**

* **Fulfillment Efficiency:** Oversee omni-channel order processing (Cin7 CORE, Shopify, ShipStation) and optimize pick-and-pack times while ensuring lot traceability.
* **Operational Budgeting (OpEx):** Help protect our margins by monitoring labor cost-per-unit, tracking waste metrics, and negotiating shipping rates with carriers.
* **Sourcing:** Direct the physical organization and cost-effective purchasing of shipping materials.

**5. Food Safety, Sanitation & Compliance**

* **Compliance Administration:** Oversee facility compliance, maintain GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) logs, and lead sanitation routines.
* **Safety Training Support:** *If you do not currently hold a PCQI or advanced HACCP certification, we will provide the training and resources to get you certified within your first 90 days.*

**Qualifications**

**Note on Qualifications:** We value a proven track record of leadership, a high level of responsibility, and a growth mindset above a "perfect" resume. If you meet the core leadership requirements, we encourage you to apply!

**What You** ***Must*** **Have (Non-Negotiable):**

* **3+ years of direct people management experience**, ideally leading hourly production, fulfillment, warehouse, or retail operations teams.
* A proven track record of growing, coaching, and organizing teams, with a reputation for high emotional intelligence and clear communication.
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities with calm and clarity.
* A "hands-on" attitude—you love being on the floor with your team, solving physical bottlenecks, and keeping spirits high.

**What is** ***Nice-to-Have*** **(Areas We Can Help Train & Grow You In):**

* Experience in food production, CPG, or manufacturing.
* Familiarity with Shopify, ShipStation, ERPs or similar Inventory/Warehouse Management Systems.
* Existing Food Safety certifications (HACCP, PCQI, GMP compliance).
* Experience designing preventive maintenance schedules for mechanical equipment.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

**Milestone**

**Expectation**

**First 30 Days**

Learn our current workflow, build trust with the hourly team, and shadow our existing fulfillment and production flows.

**First 90 Days**

Implement the PM machinery calendar, assume ownership of scheduling, and establish your first team Training Matrix.

**First 6 Months**

Successfully lead the production capacity planning and take complete ownership of floor OpEx, including labor efficiency metrics.

**First Year**

Establish a highly cross-trained, self-sufficient team that operates with calm, efficiency, and zero reactive daily fire-fighting.

**What We Offer**

* Employer-sponsored health care plan
* Dental and Vision
* 401k matched (4%)
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and sick time
* Green Commuter Benefits
* Free On-Site Parking
* Employee Discounts (Including free new releases)

Curio Spice Co. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay: $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

card.description:
**Director, Manufacturing Operations (Bulking)**

**Direct Hire**

**Onsite - Windsor, CO**

**Position Summary**

The Director, Manufacturing Operations (Bulking) provides leadership and accountability for sterile and non-sterile bulking operations within a regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. This role is responsible for safe, compliant, reliable, and efficient execution of manufacturing activities, including production performance, product quality, process reliability, workforce capability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead day-to-day bulking operations across multiple products, processes, and shifts.
* Ensure production schedules are executed safely, compliantly, and efficiently while meeting business and customer commitments.
* Drive performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, capacity, yield, cycle time, right-first-time, and equipment reliability metrics.
* Establish operating standards, performance management routines, and accountability systems across the organization.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, MS&T, Validation, Supply Chain, and Regulatory teams to improve process performance, resolve operational challenges, and support strategic objectives.
* Provide leadership for deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities.
* Support technology transfers, process scale-up, validation, equipment qualification, automation initiatives, and implementation of new manufacturing technologies.
* Develop managers, supervisors, technical specialists, and manufacturing teams while building organizational capability and succession pipelines.
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, standard work, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve reliability, reduce variability, and increase operational efficiency.
* Manage operating budgets, capital investments, staffing plans, and resource allocation while supporting future growth and capacity requirements.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, including aseptic processing, contamination control, and cGMP requirements.
* Ability to lead a diverse portfolio of complex manufacturing processes while establishing consistent standards across products, teams, and shifts.
* Demonstrated success leading and developing managers and frontline teams in a regulated manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding of process control, equipment reliability, validation, technology transfer, and manufacturing scale-up.
* Ability to interpret production, quality, capacity, and financial data and translate it into clear priorities and executable plans.
* Proficiency in risk assessment, root cause analysis, deviation investigation, CAPA, and change management.
* Track record of improving safety, quality, delivery, cost, workforce capability, and operational performance through disciplined execution.
* Strong judgment and decision-making skills, including the ability to balance patient safety, compliance, supply, and business needs.
* Effective communicator with the ability to influence senior leaders, technical partners, and frontline teams and represent Manufacturing during audits and inspections.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional work with Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, MS&T, Validation, Supply Chain, and Regulatory partners.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, tiered management, standard work, or comparable continuous improvement systems.
* Strategic, hands-on, and adaptable leadership style suited to a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or another STEM discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similarly regulated manufacturing environments, including significant production operations leadership experience.
* Significant experience in sterile or aseptic manufacturing operations required; experience with formulation, compounding, bulking, filling, or related processing strongly preferred.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience, including leadership of leaders and/or multi-shift manufacturing teams.
* Demonstrated success improving operational performance, building workforce capability, and leading cross-functional change in a regulated environment.

card.title: Senior Manager, Total Quality
card.description:
**About Crown**
---------------

Crown Holdings, Inc. through it's subsidiaries, is a world leader in the metal packaging production process. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative and sustainable metal packaging solutions and products. Our clients are some of the largest and most respected companies in the world.

Crown is dedicated to building a team of highly talented, dedicated, and driven individuals. It's an exciting time to join our business because Crown offers you the opportunity to grow and develop your skills in an expanding industry.

Crown was founded with the goal of valuing and promoting sustainability and this vision continues to be essential to our long-term future.

**Job Description:**

Location:

Mid-Atlantic or Midwest, near a major airport, or close to one of the facilities.

**Chicago, IL Lancaster/Columbus, OH Connellsville, PA Weirton, WV**

Position Overview:

 

The Sr. Manager, Total Quality provides expert-level quality assurance, continuous improvement, and food safety guidance to Crown’s Food Manufacturing facilities. This role may have an emphasis on 2-piece can manufacturing, 3-piece can manufacturing, Sheet coating, and Coil coating.

Primary Responsibilities:

* Provide problem-solving leadership on technical, quality, and food safety matters relating to food can and end performance
* Provide Corporate Quality oversight of the designated plants within area of responsibility
* Provide Quality Manager training and coverage of assigned facilities during transitions and/or absences
* Ensure adherence to customer requirements, quality control plans, SQF (Safe Quality Food) requirements, and quality/ food safety policies
* Aid plants in customer complaint responses, recalls, disposition of held product, and supplier claims
* Complete food safety related customer questionnaires and documentation requests
* Analyze process performance trends, conduct hazard analyses, identify corrective actions, and enact preventive measures within area of responsibility
* Conduct audits and surveys of Crown facilities, suppliers, warehouses, and customers
* Participate as the Quality subject matter expert on any steering committees involving assigned facilities or area of responsibility
* Collaborate with other members of the Corporate Quality team as well as the company’s Manufacturing, Engineering, and Technical Service divisions to develop and implement system improvements, strategic plans, process changes, studies and projects
* Contribute to the update and development of quality and food safety procedures and policies
* Travel requirement: 50 **-** 75%

 

Job Requirements

The ideal candidate would possess the following attributes:

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Quality Management Systems, Project Management or a related Engineering discipline.
* Minimum ten (10) years hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment with proven Quality Management System oversight capability.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, whether face-to-face, via telephone, by email, or through formal correspondence
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to professionally interact with all levels of plant personnel, company management, customers, suppliers, and auditors.
* Thorough understanding of common quality, food safety, and problem-solving tools including Control Plans, SPC (Statistical Process Control), Process Capability, Pareto charts, Histograms, Gauge R&R, FMEA, HACCP, GMP’s, Continuous Improvement and Lean Six Sigma principles
* Proficiency in data interpretation, root cause investigations, problem solving, and corrective action implementation
* Background in SQF, BRC, GFSI or ISO compliance and/or auditing
* Working knowledge of manufacturing concepts related to the processes involved in the manufacture of food cans
* Knowledge of external customer requirements, processes, and expectations preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point, and Teams)
* Strong administrative, organizational, and leadership skills
* Self-motivated and eager to take the initiative, with the ability to work effectively in a team setting and as an individual
* Committed to on-going personal development and career growth
Must have a desire for achieving excellence in customer satisfaction, process and product quality and reliability 

 

Physical Requirements

* While performing the duties of this job, the associate is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, use hands, reach with hands and arms, and may be required to balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The associate may lift and/or move up to 30 lbs.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision and ability to adjust focus. 

 

Working Conditions

* Will be required to perform job duties outside of the typical office setting in a plant environment as well as in an office.
* While performing the duties of this job, the associate may be exposed to moving mechanical parts and vehicular traffic.
* The associate may be exposed to a wide range of temperatures.
The noise level is frequently loud. 

 

* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

 

**What Crown Offers You**
-------------------------

* Strong engagement and commitment to the safety of our employees
* The opportunity to build a meaningful career
* Professional and personal development through training and work experiences

**Join us and become part of a team of professionals who are passionate about sustainable packaging!**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Working Together** Working Together is one of the five pillars that make up our Twentyby30™ program. We aim to value and respect each individual and foster an environment of inclusivity.

card.description:
**Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity**
======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.

 

Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.

 

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
* **Career growth** : Benefit from global and cross-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
* **Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing** : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
* **Productivity tools** : Utilize cutting-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

 

**Job Description:**
====================

**About the role:**

The HSEQ Director develops and implements health, safety, environmental, and quality programs for I-24 Mobility Partners and ensures compliance with OSHA, U.S. DOT, EPA, and Tennessee requirements. The Director owns the Quality Management System and Quality Management Plan, verifies program effectiveness through audits, inspections, and investigations, and has authority to stop work when there is an imminent hazard to people, property, or the environment.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review design-builder and sub-consultant quality and safety plans for alignment with the concessionaire's plans, and work with the Chief Infrastructure Officer on quality oversight of design and construction.

* Liaise with TDOT, the design-builder, the independent engineer, and external auditors on quality, safety, and environmental matters.

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve HSEQ programs, and communicate regulatory requirements and action plans to the team.

* Oversee the quality management personnel, and document control, and report HSEQ performance to stakeholders.
* Support case management of occupational injuries and illnesses, including light-duty programs, return to work, and workers' compensation information.

* Implement and own the Quality Management System and Quality Management Plan, and fulfill the Quality Manager duties assigned in the concession agreement.

* Stop work when there is an imminent hazard to the health and well-being of employees, property, or the environment.

* Lead periodic Management Reviews of the quality and environmental management systems, and promote compliance with ISO standards.

Evaluate and implement best-in-class AI and digital tools for safety analytics, incident trend detection, inspection and audit management, and document control. 

 

**Qualifications:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to fulfill those duties. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

***Education & Experience:***

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

* 12 to 15+ years of experience in HSEQ compliance, ideally in construction or transportation infrastructure

* Knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations, including OSHA, EPA, U.S. DOT, DOL, and Tennessee requirements

* Internal and external audit experience (ISO 9001, 14001, and/or 45001)

* Knowledge of the Incident Command System (ICS)

* Ability to complete OSHA 510 and OSHA 500 (OSHA Authorized Outreach Trainer) within 1 year

* Board of Certified Safety Professionals certification, or ability to obtain within 1 year

* Experience implementing or maintaining an ISO or similar certification system preferred

Working knowledge of 40 CFR environmental regulations preferred 

 

***Professional Qualities:***

* Sound judgment and courage: makes timely decisions, including stopping work when required, and stands behind them

* Audit and compliance rigor: verifies that corrective actions work and that standards are met in practice

* Influence at every level: builds relationships quickly and communicates effectively with all levels of the organization, including a culturally diverse workforce

* Clear communication: writes, presents, and speaks with precision on technical safety, environmental, and quality topics

* Analytical problem solving: uses data and trend analysis to find root causes and prevent recurrence

* Digital and AI fluency: applies AI-enabled safety, inspection, and quality tools to detect risk earlier and improve oversight

Ownership and initiative: manages tasks and tight deadlines independently in a fast-paced environment 

 

***Computer Skills:***

Must be able to demonstrate computer proficiency, especially with Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint and other PC based programs 

 

**Work Environment & Physical Demands:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The noise level in the office work environment is usually quiet; noise levels in the field may be loud, requiring hearing protection

* Some travel required, which may include air travel

* The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

* Specific vision abilities required by this job include the ability to adjust focus, as necessary to use a computer

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear

* The employee is frequently required to stand, walk and sit

Ferrovial is an equal opportunity employer. We treat all jobs applications equally, regardless of gender, color, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, covered veteran status or protected genetic information (each, a “Protected Class”), or any other protected class in accordance with applicable laws.

card.description:
***If you are an internal associate, please login to Workday and apply through Jobs Hub.***

**Job Purpose**
---------------

 

The Director of Distribution Business Process Engineering leads the design and implementation of business process workflows to support operational excellence, automation, AI-enabled efficiency, regulatory compliance, and digital modernization across distribution functions. This individual leads a team of Process Engineers to eliminate operational waste, create efficiencies, automate, apply AI where it adds value, and mitigate risk. Additionally, the Director personally owns high-priority process engineering initiatives.

 

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute complex assessment and improvement projects to remove waste, reduce costs, and scale workflows, serving as an active contributor (process mapping, analysis, solution design, etc.) in addition to directing the team's work.
* Maintain a hands-on workload of priority initiatives while managing a team of Process Engineers, typically allocating approximately 50–60% of time to individual project delivery and 40–50% to people leadership and strategic partnership.
* Coach, mentor, and direct a team of Process Engineers. Responsible for all personnel actions, including hiring, performance management, development, corrective action, and termination.
* Partner with senior leaders to establish rules, workflow design, and automation priorities and connect business goals with data-driven process solutions.
* Establish and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for workflow processes and systems to measure impact and ensure efficiency.
* Build and present reports, charts, and summaries to leadership.
* Provide forecasting and other workflow analysis to support the implementation of reengineered workflows.
* Partner with business leaders to implement new and improved business processes and systems.
* Consult with the Training & Development team to develop training materials that support the implementation of reengineered processes.
* Manage the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of business rules.
* Govern process architecture repositories, ensuring all financial workflows are fully documented for internal audit and external regulators.
* Partner with SVP, Distribution Operations to develop and execute the AI strategy for distribution.

card.description:
**Summary**

We are seeking a Director, Global Safety Operations & Quality Management to provide strategic, operational, and technical leadership across Immunic's PV operations, quality management, compliance, and inspection readiness activities for our development and post-marketing portfolio, reporting to the VP of Pharmacovigilance & Patient Safety as a key member of the Global PV leadership team. You will oversee global safety reporting, ICSR processing, aggregate reporting, safety surveillance, quality management systems, compliance, and inspection readiness, ensuring PV activities are governed, risk-based, and scalable, while providing executive-level oversight of CROs, vendors, and external service providers to ensure governance, performance management, and continuous improvement of outsourced PV activities.This is a highly collaborative and strategic role, where you must operate effectively in an evolving biotech to translate regulatory and business requirements into practical operating models, and build high-performing teams and sustainable PV capabilities.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement pharmacovigilance processes, policies, SOPs, and safety database/PV systems.
* Lead cross-functional governance, benefit-risk assessment, signal detection, and risk management efforts.
* Chair the executive safety review committee, oversee safety data exchange with partners, and contribute to industry-wide safety initiatives.
* Partner with clinical development to integrate safety into protocols, risk management plans, and safety charters.
* Provide PV oversight for regulatory filings (IND/BLA/MAA) - including Clinical Overviews, ISS, and RMPs - and review IBs, DSURs, and key CSR sections; participate in regulatory meetings as needed.
* Lead medical review of ICSRs and oversee PV team operations, quality, and compliance with global safety regulations.
* Monitor and assess CRO performance on pharmacovigilance activities.
* Recruit, hire, train, mentor, and coach PV staff, and oversee project deliverables and performance evaluations.

**Qualifications & Education**

* Healthcare professional (RN, PharmD, MD) with clinical and industry experience and a proven track record leading pharmacovigilance teams.
* Minimum of 15 years' experience in drug safety and pharmacovigilance roles in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.
* Proven leadership expertise, including a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
* In-depth knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations and compliance requirements (EMA/FDA/ICH).
* Strong leadership and strategic decision-making abilities to drive safety initiatives and ensure regulatory compliance.

Immunic Therapeutics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

**Please note, Immunic does not accept unsolicited resumes from external agencies or recruiters. Submission of a resume without a prior written agreement does not create any express or implied contract between Immunic and the agency. Immunic will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.**

Compensation Range: $220K - $260K
